name: Shenazzar
overview: Shenazzar was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, situating him within the royal lineage of Judah. There are no additional notes or details about his life or deeds.
namesAndTitles: The name Shenazzar is a proper name meaning 'may Sin protect.' This meaning reflects a common ancient Near Eastern theophoric element invoking the protection of the moon god Sin, though the name itself was not given by God according to the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shenazzar as the son of Jehoiachin, a king of Judah. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical record provided.
scriptureSignificance: Shenazzar's significance lies in his place within the Davidic royal genealogy, as the son of Jehoiachin, whose line is important in the biblical narrative for the messianic lineage. Although little is recorded about Shenazzar himself, his inclusion affirms the continuity of the Judahite royal family during a critical period in Israel's history.
